page_note: AXA 2024全年业绩演示第17页：一张无数值轴的两年堆叠柱图（GWP & Other Revenues，FY23对FY24，分三条业务线），右侧并列三列文字化百分比（Change / o/w pricing¹ / o/w volume²）以及一列要点文字。

components.evidence: FY23 and FY24 bars each split into Commercial lines, AXA XL Reinsurance, Retail lines segments
no ticks or axis line beside the bars; only FY23/FY24 labels under them
'53.0' and bold '56.5' printed above the FY23 and FY24 bar tops
'+7%' on a bracket with an arrow drawn from FY23 top to FY24 top
column headings 'o/w pricing¹' and 'o/w volume²' with superscript digits
'Change at constant scope and FX.' / '1. Price effect. 2. Includes exposure adjustments and mix & other effects.'
right-hand column of ► bullets ('Continued favorable pricing and higher volumes…') level with the plot
'In Euro billion' under the page title fixes 53.0 / 56.5 / 34.9 scale
'Commercial lines', 'AXA XL Reinsurance', 'Retail lines' set as a left column level with their segments
FY24 bar drawn in saturated mid/navy blue while the FY23 bar is pale blue

new_components.name: value_columns_aligned_to_stack_segments
new_components.evidence: 'Change', 'o/w pricing¹', 'o/w volume²' columns print percentages on rows aligned with each stacked segment
new_components.why_it_matters: 这些百分比不是图形标记，而是与堆叠段行对齐的文字列；要定位一个数值必须同时给出段名（行）和列名，否则+3%、+10%会重复无法区分。

new_components.name: negative_value_in_text_column
new_components.evidence: '-3%' printed in the o/w volume² column for the Retail lines row, no axis or zero line
new_components.why_it_matters: 负值只以文字出现，没有零线或轴可参照，解析时容易丢掉负号或与相邻的+10%串行。

new_components.name: bold_column_emphasis
new_components.evidence: '+6%', '+10%', '+7%' in the Change column are bold; pricing/volume columns are light grey
new_components.why_it_matters: 字重区分主列与分解列，是唯一提示'Change'列为汇总量的线索，纯文本导出后该层级消失。

new_components.name: tinted_column_panel
new_components.evidence: a light grey rounded rectangle sits behind the whole 'Change' column of percentages
new_components.why_it_matters: 底色把Change列圈成一个视觉块，读数时要靠它判断某个百分比属于Change而非旁边两列。

difficulty_notes: 数值本身全部印出（34.9、2.5、19.1、53.0、56.5和五个百分比），第2步几乎无风险——图上根本没有刻度轴，无需按像素读数。真正卡住的是寻址：+3%在Commercial lines行的o/w pricing¹和o/w volume²两列各出现一次，+10%同时是AXA XL Reinsurance的Change和Retail lines的o/w pricing¹，因此每个百分比至少需要'行=业务线'加'列=Change / o/w pricing¹ / o/w volume²'两把钥匙；而这三列只是与堆叠段对齐的文字，解析器很可能把它们并入柱图或拆成互不相连的碎片，列名还带上标¹²容易丢失。此外柱内数值需要第三把钥匙FY23/FY24才能与百分比区分。
